arguments.code:
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
page_limit = 20
page_index = 0
all_songs = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    all_songs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
print('total_songs:', len(all_songs))
print('first5_song_ids:', [s['song_id'] for s in all_songs[:5]])
print('last5_song_ids:', [s['song_id'] for s in all_songs[-5:]])

print('all_songs_len:', len(all_songs) if 'all_songs' in globals() else None)
print('has_access_token:', 'access_token' in globals())
print('keys_example:', all_songs[0].keys() if 'all_songs' in globals() else None)

access_token = login_resp['access_token']
# build play counts for all songs in library
song_stats = []
for s in all_songs:
    song_id = s['song_id']
    song_details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
    play_count = song_details.get('play_count', None)
    song_stats.append({
        'song_id': song_id,
        'title': song_details.get('title', s.get('title')),
        'play_count': play_count
    })
# sort by play_count ascending, then song_id ascending
song_stats_sorted = sorted(song_stats, key=lambda x: (x['play_count'], x['song_id']))
print('song_stats:', song_stats)
print('sorted_first:', song_stats_sorted[0])
print('min_play_count:', song_stats_sorted[0]['play_count'])
# list all songs with min play_count
min_val = song_stats_sorted[0]['play_count']
mins = [x for x in song_stats_sorted if x['play_count'] == min_val]
print('all_min_songs:', mins)
